name: Sunray Hampton 300TN | 3-Person Indoor Traditional Sauna
description: Description he Hampton indoor traditional sauna with a Harvia heater is the perfect getaway for friends and family. The Hampton includes an elevated rear bench and side bench seat for optimal comfort and relaxation for 2-3 people. The Hampton traditional sauna comes with a 4.5kW Harvia electric heater. Harvia heaters are world-renowned for providing high-quality electric sauna heaters that are both durable and dependable. The dual bench seating layout of the Hampton offers ample space up to 3 people to enjoy the intense heat while relaxing in comfort against the integrated ergonomic backrest. A water cask and spoon are included to add water to the heater stones to provide humidity and steam for more intense heat. Standard features include a thermo-hygrometer for displaying the humidity level, interior dome lighting, a ventilation system, and a cabin constructed of natural Canadian Cedar wood for durable yet naturally appealing decor. Specifications Exterior Product Dimensions H 80" x W 70" x D 47" Interior Product Dimensions H 72" x W 64" x D 43" Weight 425 lb. Power 220V, 50/60HZ 30 AMP Dedicated Outlet Required 4500 Watts Features Canadian Cedar Construction 4.5kW Harvia Heater 2 Tiered Bench Seating for Comfort and Relaxation Tempered Glass Ergonomic Backrest Included Ventilation System Cask and Spoon Hygrometer/Sand Timer Upgraded Door Handle 7 Year Warranty Documents Product Data Sheet TN Series Assembly Manual
